title: Full Stack Developer
description: We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced "Full Stack Developer" The job is primarily remote but we expect the candidates to be in Istanbul. Join us if you have a penchant to develop solutions with cutting-edge applications for a better world. What Are The Required Qualifications? Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or related fields 5+ years of professional software development experience Deep understanding and demonstrated experience in .Net Framework and C# libraries Angular knowledge is required.
